attributes.board_name: South Carolina Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners (LLR)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs of AVMA, AAHA, NAVTA, Veterinary Hospital Managers Association, AAVSB RACE (RACEtrack hours transfer to CE Broker), state veterinary medical and vet-tech associations, AVMA/NAVTA-recognized specialty organizations, or other Board-approved programs
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE is waived for the first year of licensure.
rules.audit_note: CE Broker is the Board's official CE tracking system. Keep attendance records at least 3 years before renewal.
rules.legal_basis: S.C. Code Regs. 120-6 (amended eff. May 23, 2025); S.C. Code §40-69-255
rules.notes: Licensed veterinary technicians: 12 h per biennial renewal, at least 6 h veterinary medical; at least 6 h live in person or live digital interactive, max 6 h prerecorded or written.
